summary: Sprint E validated: public /pourquoi page + admin analytics dashboard fully working. Backend 19/19 pytest passing (auth guards, endpoint shapes, days clamp). Frontend: /pourquoi renders all 15 data-testids (hero/title/stats(4 cards)/3 pillars/4 studies with real journal links to nejm.org, neurology.org, academic.oup.com, cta, ehpad/register CTAs). Footer contains footer-pourquoi (/pourquoi) and footer-ehpad (/ehpad). Admin analytics page (/app/admin/analytics) renders with all KPI cards (users/paid/mrr/dau), recharts LineChart signups, BarChart revenue, categories table, atelier KPIs. admin-analytics-refresh works without errors. Navbar shows nav-admin-analytics for admin.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_analytics.py aggregates on collections created_at stored as ISO strings — string-based date comparisons work but fragile if any doc stores datetime; consider standardising storage.
MRR estimate uses hardcoded price map {club:4.99, famille:7.99, premium:12.99} — duplicates pricing logic from packages; risk of drift. Consider centralising in one config.
signups endpoint fetches up to 20000 user docs into memory then buckets in Python — for >180d/large userbase would be more efficient as $group aggregation pipeline. Acceptable at current scale.
